70	/-- **Descent of an Abel-correct divisor witness along an étale cover**: a widened divisor
71	class over the carrier of an étale cover of `A` whose Abel value is the restriction of the
72	input rank-one plus class descends to a unique Abel-correct widened divisor class over `A`.
73	
74	The tensor-square cocycle condition of `DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq` is not
75	assumed: it is manufactured from the uniqueness interface, applied over the tensor square of
76	the carrier to the two coprojection pullbacks of the witness — both have Abel value the
77	restriction of the input class along the (single) structure map `A → E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier`,
78	because the two coprojections agree after the structure map of the cover.  The Abel value of
79	the descended class is recovered by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`
80	(`PicEtAff.map_injective_of_etaleCover`). -/
81	theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness
82	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
83	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
84	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A))
85	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
86	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (F' : DivFamZarAff C E.Carrier (genus C))
87	    (habel : abelDivAffPlus C E.Carrier F' =
88	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
89	        (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) :
90	    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
91	      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
92	  classical
93	  set φ0 : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier := (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφ0
94	  set φL : E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
95	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
96	      E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφL
97	  set φR : E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
98	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
99	      E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφR
100	  set ψ : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier := φL.comp φ0 with hψ
101	  -- both coprojections restrict to the structure map of the tensor square
102	  have hψR : φR.comp φ0 = ψ := by
103	    rw [hψ]
104	    exact AlgHom.ext fun a =>
105	      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
106	        E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).commutes a).trans
107	        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
108	          E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).commutes a).symm
109	  -- the input class restricted to the tensor square stays in the rank-one locus
110	  set lam_sq : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ)
111	      (overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)) :=
112	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.overSpecMap ψ).op lam with hlam_sq_def
113	  have hlam_sq : lam_sq ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj
114	      (op (overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier))) :=
115	    picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi (Over.overSpecMap ψ).op hlam
116	  have hsq : picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1
117	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C ψ (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :=
118	    picEtAffineEquiv_naturality C ψ lam.1
119	  -- both coprojection pullbacks of the witness have the restricted Abel value
120	  have habelL : abelDivAffPlus C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)
121	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φL F')
122	      = picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1 := by
123	    rw [hsq, ← abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φL F', habel, ← PicEtAff.mapAlg_comp, ← hψ]
124	  have habelR : abelDivAffPlus C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)
125	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φR F')
126	      = picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1 := by
127	    rw [hsq, ← abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φR F', habel, ← PicEtAff.mapAlg_comp, hψR]
128	  -- uniqueness over the tensor square manufactures the descent cocycle
129	  have htensor : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φL F' = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φR F' :=
130	    hu (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq hlam_sq _ _ habelL habelR
131	  obtain ⟨F, hF, -⟩ := DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq E F' htensor
132	  rw [← hφ0] at hF
133	  -- the Abel value of the descended class, by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`
134	  have hmapF : PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (abelDivAffPlus C A F)
135	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) := by
136	    rw [abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φ0 F, hF, habel]
137	  have habelF : abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
138	    apply PicEtAff.map_injective_of_etaleCover C E
139	    rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C φ0 rfl,
140	      PicEtAff.mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C φ0 rfl] at hmapF
141	    exact hmapF
142	  exact ⟨F, habelF, fun G hG => hu A lam hlam G F hG habelF⟩
143	
144	/-- **The unique Abel-correct divisor of a rank-one local presentation**: over a rank-one
145	plus class with a tied local presentation on a Noetherian étale carrier, there is a unique
146	widened divisor class over the test algebra whose Abel value is the input class.
147	
148	Existence: the finite glue
149	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation.exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation`
150	produces an Abel-correct witness over the presentation carrier, which descends by
151	`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness`.  Uniqueness is the interface `hu`. -/
152	theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation
153	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
154	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
155	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
156	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
157	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
158	    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
159	      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
160	  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, F0, -, -, habel, -, -, -⟩ :=
161	    P.exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
162	  exact existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness pi hu lam hlam P.cover F0 habel
163	
164	/-- **The canonical rank-one divisor of a presentation**: the unique widened divisor class
165	over the test algebra whose Abel value is the presented rank-one plus class, chosen from
166	`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation`.  By uniqueness, the choice does not
167	depend on the internal data of the glue — only on the class, the membership certificate,
168	and the presentation carrier's Noetherianity. -/
169	noncomputable def canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation
170	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
171	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
172	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
173	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
174	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
175	    DivFamZarAff C A (genus C) :=
176	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi hu hlam P).choose
177	
178	/-- The canonical rank-one divisor satisfies the Abel equation: its widened Abel value is
179	the presented rank-one plus class. -/
180	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation_abel
181	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
182	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
183	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
184	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
185	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
186	    abelDivAffPlus C A (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation pi hu hlam P)
187	      = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 :=
188	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi hu hlam P).choose_spec.1
189	
190	/-- Any Abel-correct widened divisor class equals the canonical rank-one divisor. -/
191	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation_unique
192	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
193	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
194	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
195	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
196	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
197	    (F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C))
198	    (hF : abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :
199	    F = canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation pi hu hlam P :=
200	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi hu hlam P).choose_spec.2 F hF
201

14	/-!
15	# Discharge of the rank-one divisor uniqueness interface
16	
17	`rankOneDivisorUniqueness` proves `RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi` outright: over every affine
18	test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened locally certified
19	divisor class of degree `genus C` has Abel value the input class.  No auxiliary hypotheses
20	remain — the interface consumed by the canonical-divisor descent is closed.
21	
22	The proof composes the landed engines and is local-to-global twice, both times genuinely:
23	
24	* membership in `PicRankOneOpen` tested at the identity yields a presentation `P` of the
25	  input class over the test algebra itself, with an étale carrier `B := P.cover.Carrier`
26	  carrying the cocycle datum and its four rank-one certificates;
27	* both families restrict along the faithfully flat `S → B`, where their Abel values become
28	  the `PicEtAff.unit` of `P.representative` (`mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self`), so étale
29	  separatedness (`PicEtAff.unit_injective`) matches both `relPic` classes with the datum's
30	  Čech class;
31	* near every prime of `B` the base-discrepancy localization
32	  (`exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq`) upgrades the two `relPic` equalities to
33	  on-the-nose `CechPic` equalities on a basic open — the two localizations are merged by
34	  multiplying the two good elements;
35	* on each such basic open the datum base-changes with its certificates
36	  (`RankOneFamilyCertificates.scalarExtension`), and the datum-class uniqueness core
37	  (`divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass`) forces the two restricted families to
38	  agree;
39	* the good elements span the unit ideal (`exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime`), so the
40	  away-span separatedness (`DivFamZarAff.eq_of_awaySpan_eq`) closes equality over `B`, and
41	  faithfully-flat injectivity (`DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat`) closes
42	  it over the test algebra.
43	
44	The rank-one hypothesis enters irreplaceably through the certificates feeding the
45	uniqueness core's unit-extraction engine; the glue-backs cover `Spec B` and descend a
46	faithfully flat cover of `Spec S`, so neither is the trivial converse (the two traps of the
47	uniqueness-discharge memory).  As immediate consumers, the canonical rank-one divisor and
48	its accessors are re-exported with the interface hypothesis discharged
49	(`canonicalRankOneDivisor`, `existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_presentation`).
50	-/

65	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
66	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
67	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

70	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
71	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
72	/-- Equality of Čech Picard classes after base change to an away localization persists to
73	the away localization at any multiple: for `a * b = f` the comparison
74	`Localization.Away a →ₐ[k] Localization.Away f` interposes, and the relative-curve
75	comparisons compose over the tower `B → B_a → B_f`. -/
76	private lemma cechPicMap_away_eq_of_mul {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
77	    (a b f : B) (hab : a * b = f) {L L' : (relCurve C B).CechPic}
78	    (h : Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away a)) L
79	        = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away a)) L') :
80	    Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away f)) L
81	      = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away f)) L' := by
82	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away f) :=
83	    (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd (k := k) f a b hab).toRingHom.toAlgebra
84	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away f) :=
85	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x =>
86	      ((DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd (k := k) f a b hab).commutes x).symm
87	  haveI : IsScalarTower B (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away f) :=
88	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x =>
89	      (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap (k := k) f a b hab x).symm
90	  have hcomp : Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away f))
91	      = (Scheme.CechPic.map
92	          (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away f))).comp
93	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B (Localization.Away a))) := by
94	    rw [← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp]
95	  rw [hcomp]
96	  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply]
97	  exact congrArg _ h

99	/-- **Per-prime local agreement with the datum**: two widened divisor families over the
100	presentation carrier whose `picClass`es agree with the datum's Čech class in the relative
101	Picard group agree on the nose after restriction to a basic open around any given prime.
102	
103	The base-discrepancy localization produces one good element per family; their product is
104	good for both, the datum base-changes with its four rank-one certificates, and the
105	datum-class uniqueness core forces the two restricted families to coincide. -/
106	theorem PicRankOneLocalPresentation.exists_notMem_mapAlgHom_eq
107	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
108	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
109	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
110	    {F G : DivFamZarAff C P.cover.Carrier (genus C)}
111	    (hF : relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F.picClass
112	        = relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass)
113	    (hG : relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) G.picClass
114	        = relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass)
115	    (q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
116	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
117	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
118	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)) F
119	        = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
120	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)) G := by
121	  classical
122	  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, h₁⟩ := exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq hF q
123	  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂, h₂⟩ := exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq hG q
124	  have hmul : f₁ * f₂ ∉ q.asIdeal := fun hmem => by
125	    rcases q.isPrime.mem_or_mem hmem with h | h
126	    exacts [hf₁ h, hf₂ h]
127	  refine ⟨f₁ * f₂, hmul, ?_⟩
128	  set B' := Localization.Away (f₁ * f₂)
129	  -- both restricted families have `picClass` the base-changed datum class on the nose
130	  have h₁' := cechPicMap_away_eq_of_mul (C := C) f₁ f₂ (f₁ * f₂) rfl h₁
131	  have h₂' := cechPicMap_away_eq_of_mul (C := C) f₂ f₁ (f₁ * f₂) (mul_comm f₂ f₁) h₂
132	  have hFpic : (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
133	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier B') F).picClass
134	      = (P.datum.baseChange B').cechPicClass := by
135	    rw [DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg _ (fun _ => rfl), DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg,
136	      P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B']
137	    exact h₁'
138	  have hGpic : (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
139	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier B') G).picClass
140	      = (P.datum.baseChange B').cechPicClass := by
141	    rw [DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg _ (fun _ => rfl), DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg,
142	      P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B']
143	    exact h₂'
144	  -- the presentation's four certificates base-change to the basic open
145	  have cert : RankOneFamilyCertificates (P.datum.baseChange B') :=
146	    (RankOneFamilyCertificates.mk P.h1_vanishing P.h0_finite P.h0_projective
147	      P.h0_rank_one).scalarExtension B'
148	  exact BasicOpenCocycleDatum.divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass
149	    (P.datum.baseChange B') cert.h1_vanishing cert.h0_finite cert.h0_projective
150	    cert.h0_rank_one _ _ hFpic hGpic

152	/-- **The rank-one divisor uniqueness interface holds** (the T5 discharge): over every
153	affine test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened locally
154	certified divisor class of degree `genus C` has Abel value the input class.
155	
156	Injectivity is restored on the rank-one locus precisely because the presentation's `H⁰` is
157	finite projective of stalk rank one — single-point linear systems — which feeds the
158	unit-extraction engine of the datum-class uniqueness core; away from the locus the widened
159	Abel map is genuinely non-injective (`Pic0ChartAbelNonInjective`). -/
160	theorem rankOneDivisorUniqueness : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi := by
161	  intro S _ _ lam hlam F G hF hG
162	  classical
163	  -- a presentation of the input class, from the identity test; its plus class is `lam.1`
164	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mp hlam S (𝟙 (overSpec k S))
165	  have e : ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map
166	      (𝟙 (overSpec k S)).op lam).1 = lam.1 :=
167	    picEtMap_id C lam.1
168	  -- inject along the faithfully flat étale carrier
169	  apply DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat
170	    (S := S) (S' := P.cover.Carrier)
171	  set φ0 : S →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S P.cover.Carrier with hφ0
172	  -- the restricted Abel values are the unit of the representative, so both restricted
173	  -- `picClass`es agree with the datum's Čech class in the relative Picard group
174	  have hofId : ((Algebra.ofId S P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k) = φ0 :=
175	    AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
176	  have hrep : PicEtAff.mk C P.cover P.representative = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 := by
177	    rw [← e]
178	    exact P.represents
179	  have htarget : PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1)
180	      = PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
181	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
182	    rw [← hrep, ← hofId, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
183	  have key : ∀ H : DivFamZarAff C S (genus C),
184	      abelDivAffPlus C S H = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 →
185	      relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
186	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 H).picClass
187	        = relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass := by
188	    intro H hH
189	    rw [← P.datum_class]
190	    apply PicEtAff.unit_injective C P.cover.Carrier
191	    calc PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
192	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 H).picClass)
193	        = abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 H) := rfl
194	      _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (abelDivAffPlus C S H) :=
195	          (abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φ0 H).symm
196	      _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1) := by rw [hH]
197	      _ = PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
198	            (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := htarget
199	  -- per-prime agreement, upgraded to a finite spanning family, separates over the carrier
200	  obtain ⟨m, g, hgspan, hggood⟩ := exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime
201	    (fun f => DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
202	        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))
203	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 F)
204	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
205	        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))
206	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 G))
207	    (fun q => P.exists_notMem_mapAlgHom_eq pi (key F hF) (key G hG) q)
208	  exact DivFamZarAff.eq_of_awaySpan_eq g hgspan hggood

210	/-! ## Immediate consumers: the canonical rank-one divisor, unconditionally -/
211	
212	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
213	  {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
214	
215	/-- The unique Abel-correct divisor of a rank-one local presentation, with the uniqueness
216	interface discharged. -/
217	theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_presentation
218	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
219	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
220	    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
221	      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 :=
222	  existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi
223	    (rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi) hlam P

227	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
228	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
229	    DivFamZarAff C A (genus C) :=

235	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :

237	      = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 :=
238	  canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation_abel pi (rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi) hlam P

241	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisor_unique

16	/-!
17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
18	
19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
23	
24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
29	
30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
36	-/

59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
60	
61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
69	  represents :
70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
72	  datum_class :
73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
76	  module_iso :
77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
90	  h0_rank_one :
91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

104	/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.

106	This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
107	noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
108	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]

111	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=

116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj

120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶

123	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module

126	
127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
128	
129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
142	    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)

144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
156	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
158	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
159	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
162	cartesian base change. -/
163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)
183	
184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module

213	This is the consumer-facing specialization for the future zero-locus construction: it keeps
214	the coefficient ring `B` and `relCurveMap` explicit while retaining the canonical cartesian
215	square, rather than introducing a second base-change witness. -/
216	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIsoAffine_hom_evaluation
217	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
218	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
219	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
220	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso

232	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
233	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
234	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

311	/-- The conditional divisor datum cut by a base-changed presentation section.
312	
313	The explicit `hsec` hypothesis is the non-vacuous fibrewise nonvanishing input.  It is
314	converted componentwise to the injectivity required by the fibrewise-regular section
315	construction; the integral fibre instance is installed from the standing geometrically
316	irreducible curve hypotheses.
317	-/
318	noncomputable def sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
319	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
320	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
321	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
322	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
323	    (hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
324	      (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
325	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0) :
326	    (relCurve C B).LocalEquations :=
327	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
328	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
329	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
330	  D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s
331	    (fun j q => by
332	      letI : IsIntegral (relCurve C q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
333	        instIsIntegralBaseChange C q.asIdeal.ResidueField
334	      exact D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero s q (hsec q) j)

339	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
340	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
341	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
342	    (hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
343	      (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
344	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0) :
345	    (P.sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange B y hsec).picClass =
346	      (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass := by
347	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
348	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
349	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
350	  unfold sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
351	  exact D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_picClass s
352	    (fun j q => by
353	      letI : IsIntegral (relCurve C q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
354	        instIsIntegralBaseChange C q.asIdeal.ResidueField
355	      exact D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero s q (hsec q) j)

360	  (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv P.module_iso.symm 0).trans
361	    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
362	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))

365	        (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module))

367	/-- The native section is exactly the datum section transported through `module_iso`. -/
368	theorem module_iso_inv_datumSection (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
369	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
370	    (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens))).hom

434	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
435	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
436	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
437	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
438	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
439	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
440	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
441	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
442	    intro hf
443	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
444	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)
445	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f
446	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
447	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
448	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
449	      (hy p hfp)
450	    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
451	  have hcom : p.asIdeal =
452	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
453	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
454	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
455	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom

457	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
458	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
459	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom
460	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
461	    LinearEquiv.ofBijective rho.toLinearMap hrho
462	  have he := (e.rTensor Q).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hp

778	/-- A datum presenting an affine representative of a genus-degree class has degree `genus C`
779	after every field-valued coefficient extension.
780	
781	These are exactly the first five, canonical inputs of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Stating
782	the calculation before the remaining native and cohomological fields lets the family producer
783	use it when proving rank one, without assuming the completed presentation it is constructing. -/
784	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange_of_representation
785	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
786	    (x : descentClasses C E)
787	    (hrep : PicEtAff.mk C E x = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)
788	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C E.Carrier pi)
789	    (hclass :
790	      (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) =
791	        relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) D.cechPicClass)
792	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra E.Carrier L]
793	    [IsScalarTower k E.Carrier L] :
794	    classDeg L
795	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C E.Carrier L)
796	        D.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
797	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier :=
798	    (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k
799	  let psi : E.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
800	    (Algebra.ofId E.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
801	  have hcurve :
802	      relCurveMap C E.Carrier L =
803	        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
804	    refine congrArg
805	      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
806	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
807	  have hpresentation :
808	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
809	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
810	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
811	    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
812	      C lam.1 E x hrep.symm
813	  calc
814	    classDeg L
815	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C E.Carrier L)
816	          D.cechPicClass) =
817	      relPicDeg L
818	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
819	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C E.Carrier L)
820	            D.cechPicClass)) :=
821	      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
822	    _ = relPicDeg L
823	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
824	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
825	            D.cechPicClass)) := by
826	      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
827	      rfl
828	    _ = relPicDeg L
829	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
830	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier))) := by
831	      rw [hclass]
832	    _ = degAt
833	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
834	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)))
835	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
836	      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
837	        (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier))
838	        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
839	    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
840	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
841	    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
842	      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
843	    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)
844	
845	/-- The cocycle datum tied to a completed presentation has class degree `genus C`
846	after every field-valued coefficient extension. -/
847	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
848	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
849	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
850	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
851	    classDeg L
852	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
853	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C :=
854	  datum_classDeg_baseChange_of_representation
855	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class L
856	
857	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation

99	-- The same construction synthesizes two nontrivial scalar-tower module structures.
100	/-- Produce all four certificates for the displayed datum over an arbitrary coefficient ring.
101	
102	The only H1 input is a divisor witness on each residue field.  It first gives pair-H1
103	vanishing for the displayed datum.  A finite presentation of that datum is then refined until
104	the same pair-H1 vanishing holds at the stage itself; the Noetherian rigid engine is used only
105	at that stage.  Its finite-projective H0 is transported back canonically, and rank one is
106	computed on the displayed datum from its own class-degree law. -/
107	noncomputable def ofActualDatum
108	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
109	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
110	    (hW : D.ResidueH1Witness)
111	    (hdegree : D.FibreClassDegree (genus C)) :

117	  have hpair : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1 :=
118	    by
119	      letI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₀ hpi
120	      letI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₁ hpi
121	      letI : Module.Finite B (datumPair D).H1 :=
122	        (datumPair D).moduleFinite_h1
123	      exact
124	        AlgebraicJacobian.RigidEngine.subsingleton_of_forall_subsingleton_residueField_tensor
125	          hfib
126	  have h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 1) :=
127	    (subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mp hpair
128	
129	  obtain ⟨B0, hB0fg, D0, hD0⟩ := D.exists_fg_subalgebra_baseChange_eq
130	  have hpairBase : Subsingleton (datumPair (D0.baseChange (B' := B))).H1 := by
131	    rw [hD0]
132	    exact hpair
133	  have htensor : Subsingleton ((datumPair D0).H1 ⊗[B0] B) :=
134	    D0.subsingleton_h1_tensor_of_baseChange B hpairBase
135	  obtain ⟨A, _, _, hAnoeth, hpairA, hAA⟩ :=
136	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_fg_pairH1_vanishing_stage
137	      (C := C) (pi := pi) B0 hB0fg D0 hpi htensor
138	
139	  letI : IsNoetherianRing A := hAnoeth
140	  letI : Subsingleton (datumPair (D0.baseChange A)).H1 := hpairA
141	  have hfibA : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
142	      Subsingleton
143	        ((datumPair (D0.baseChange A)).H1 ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
144	    intro p
145	    infer_instance
146	  letI := (D0.baseChange A).moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₀ hpi
147	  letI := (D0.baseChange A).moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₁ hpi
148	  letI := (D0.baseChange A).projective_sections₀
149	  letI := (D0.baseChange A).projective_sections₁
150	  letI := (D0.baseChange A).projective_sectionsInf
151	  letI : Module.Projective A
152	      (((D0.baseChange A).sheaf.obj.obj
153	          (op (relCover C A (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀)) ×
154	        ((D0.baseChange A).sheaf.obj.obj
155	          (op (relCover C A (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁))) :=
156	    Module.Projective.prod
157	  obtain ⟨_, hfiniteA, hprojectiveA⟩ :=
158	    (D0.baseChange A).pairData.rigidEngine
159	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C A (fiberTwoCover pi))
160	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C A (fiberTwoCover pi))
161	      (relCover_sup C A (fiberTwoCover pi)) hfibA
162	
163	  have hbase : (D0.baseChange A).baseChange B = D := hAA.trans hD0
164	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule (D0.baseChange A).sheaf 0
165	  letI : Module.Finite A Q := hfiniteA
166	  letI : Module.Projective A Q := hprojectiveA
167	  let e : B ⊗[A] Q ≃ₗ[B] Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0 :=
168	    ((D0.baseChange A).datumH0BaseChange B hpairA).trans
169	      (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv
170	        (eqToIso (congrArg
171	          (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi => E.sheaf) hbase)) 0)
172	  letI : Module.Finite B (B ⊗[A] Q) := by infer_instance
173	  letI : Module.Projective B (B ⊗[A] Q) := by infer_instance
174	  have hfinite : Module.Finite B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :=
175	    Module.Finite.equiv e
176	  have hprojective : Module.Projective B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :=
177	    Module.Projective.of_equiv e
178	  have hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
179	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1 :=
180	    D.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one_of_actualPairH1
181	      (n := genus C) (chi_moduleKSheaf C) hpair hfinite hprojective hdegree

12	/-!
13	# Finite-stage descent of rank-one H1 vanishing
14	
15	Vanishing after extension to an arbitrary coefficient ring is witnessed by finitely many
16	relations when the source module is finite.  This file descends those relations to a finitely
17	generated intermediate subalgebra, then applies the result to the actual `H1` module of a pinned
18	cocycle datum.  The resulting datum is tied to the original one by the cocycle base-change tower
19	law.
20	-/
21	
22	set_option autoImplicit false
23	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
25	
26	universe u v w
27	
28	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
29	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
30	open scoped TensorProduct
31	
32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
33	
34	open AlgebraicJacobian
35	
36	namespace RankOneFamilyCertificates
37	
38	/-- If a finite module becomes zero after scalar extension, it already becomes zero over a
39	finitely generated intermediate subalgebra.
40	
41	The proof descends the finitely many relations `1 ⊗ generator = 0` separately using the
42	direct-limit theorem for tensor products, then takes their finite supremum. -/
43	theorem exists_fg_subalgebra_tensor_subsingleton
44	    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {M : Type w}
45	    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
46	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
47	    (hS : Subsingleton (S ⊗[R] M)) :
48	    ∃ A : Subalgebra R S, A.FG ∧ Subsingleton (A ⊗[R] M) := by
49	  classical
50	  obtain ⟨n, s, hs⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := R) (M := M)
51	  let A0 : Subalgebra R S := ⊥
52	  let t : Fin n → A0 ⊗[R] M := fun i => (1 : A0) ⊗ₜ[R] s i
53	  have ht : ∀ i, A0.val.toLinearMap.rTensor M (t i) =
54	      A0.val.toLinearMap.rTensor M 0 := by
55	    intro i
56	    exact hS.elim _ _
57	  choose A hA0 hAfg hAzero using fun i =>
58	    TensorProduct.Algebra.eq_of_fg_of_subtype_eq
59	      (A := A0) Subalgebra.fg_bot (ht i)
60	  let B : Subalgebra R S := Finset.univ.sup A
61	  have hBfg : B.FG := by
62	    dsimp only [B]
63	    induction (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) using Finset.induction_on with
64	    | empty => simpa using (Subalgebra.fg_bot : (⊥ : Subalgebra R S).FG)
65	    | @insert a q ha ih =>
66	        simpa [Finset.sup_insert] using (hAfg a).sup ih
67	  have hAB : ∀ i, A i ≤ B := by
68	    intro i
69	    exact Finset.le_sup (s := Finset.univ) (f := A) (Finset.mem_univ i)
70	  have hgen_zero : ∀ i, (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] s i = 0 := by
71	    intro i
72	    have hi := congrArg
73	      ((Subalgebra.inclusion (hAB i)).toLinearMap.rTensor M) (hAzero i)
74	    simpa [t, A0] using hi
75	  let f : M →ₗ[R] B ⊗[R] M := (TensorProduct.mk R B M) 1
76	  have hspan : Submodule.span R (Set.range s) ≤ LinearMap.ker f := by
77	    rw [Submodule.span_le]
78	    rintro m ⟨i, rfl⟩
79	    exact hgen_zero i
80	  have hf : f = 0 := by
81	    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_top]
82	    exact top_unique (hs ▸ hspan)
83	  have hone : ∀ m : M, (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] m = 0 := by
84	    intro m
85	    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf m
86	  have hall : ∀ z : B ⊗[R] M, z = 0 := by
87	    intro z
88	    induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
89	    | zero => rfl
90	    | tmul b m =>
91	        calc
92	          b ⊗ₜ[R] m = b • ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] m) := by
93	            rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
94	            simp
95	          _ = 0 := by rw [hone]; simp
96	    | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
97	  exact ⟨B, hBfg, ⟨fun x y => (hall x).trans (hall y).symm⟩⟩
98	
99	end RankOneFamilyCertificates

110	/-- Tensor vanishing of the datum pair's `H1` forces `H1` of the actual base-changed datum pair
111	to vanish.  This is the forward half of the Cech base-change dictionary over an arbitrary ring,
112	not only over residue fields. -/
113	theorem subsingleton_pairH1_baseChange_of_tensor
114	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi)
115	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra R A]
116	    [IsScalarTower k R A]
117	    (h : Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[R] A)) :
118	    Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange A)).H1 := by
119	  have hcok := ((datumPair D).subsingleton_h1_rTensor_iff A).mp h
120	  have hbc : Function.Surjective ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange A) := by
121	    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top]
122	    exact Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mp hcok
123	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (datumPair (D.baseChange A)).diff :=
124	    RigidEngine.surjective_congr _ _ (D.datumDomBaseChange A)
125	      (D.termBaseChangeInf A) (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange A x) hbc
126	  have himg : (datumPair (D.baseChange A)).imageLattice = ⊤ := by
127	    rw [← (datumPair (D.baseChange A)).range_diff_eq, LinearMap.range_eq_top]
128	    exact hsurj
129	  rw [TwoLatticePair.H1, himg]
130	  infer_instance
131	
132	/-- Refine a finitely generated coefficient stage until the actual datum pair has vanishing
133	`H1`.  The refined ring is finite type over the ground field, hence Noetherian, and its datum
134	base-changes to exactly the same datum over the ambient coefficient ring. -/
135	theorem exists_fg_pairH1_vanishing_stage
136	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
137	    (R0 : Subalgebra k S) (hR0 : R0.FG)
138	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (R0 : Type u) pi)
139	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
140	    (hS : Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[R0] S)) :
141	    ∃ A : Subalgebra (R0 : Type u) S,
142	      A.FG ∧ Algebra.FiniteType k A ∧ IsNoetherianRing A ∧
143	        Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange A)).H1 ∧
144	        (D.baseChange A).baseChange S = D.baseChange S := by
145	  letI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₀ hpi
146	  letI := D.moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₁ hpi
147	  letI : Module.Finite (R0 : Type u) (datumPair D).H1 :=
148	    (datumPair D).moduleFinite_h1
149	  have hS' : Subsingleton (S ⊗[R0] (datumPair D).H1) :=
150	    (TensorProduct.comm (R0 : Type u) (datumPair D).H1 S).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp hS
151	  obtain ⟨A, hAfg, hAtensor⟩ :=
152	    RankOneFamilyCertificates.exists_fg_subalgebra_tensor_subsingleton hS'
153	  have hAtensor' : Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[R0] A) :=
154	    (TensorProduct.comm (R0 : Type u) (datumPair D).H1 A).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr
155	      hAtensor
156	  have hApair : Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange A)).H1 :=
157	    D.subsingleton_pairH1_baseChange_of_tensor A hAtensor'
158	  have hR0ft : Algebra.FiniteType k R0 :=
159	    (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType R0).mp hR0
160	  have hAft : Algebra.FiniteType (R0 : Type u) A :=
161	    (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType A).mp hAfg
162	  have hAkt : Algebra.FiniteType k A := Algebra.FiniteType.trans hR0ft hAft
163	  letI : Algebra.FiniteType k A := hAkt
164	  have hAnoeth : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k A
165	  exact ⟨A, hAfg, hAkt, hAnoeth, hApair,
166	    D.baseChange_baseChange C (R0 : Type u) A S⟩
167

11	/-!
12	# DAT-C C2 — the rank-1 H⁰ export and the generator kit
13	(`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-3 Σ-RANK1, §2 (N1)/(N3))
14	
15	On the fibrewise h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization
16	`χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`, the datum engine's `H⁰` is an **invertible** module: finite,
17	projective, and of stalk-rank exactly `1`.  This is the rank export the engine
18	(`datumRigidEngine`, `Cohomology/GluedSheafEngine.lean`) leaves open — it delivers
19	finite + projective, never `rankAtStalk = 1`.
20	
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chi_relCurve` — the χ transport `χ(𝒪_{C_L}) = 1 − n` to every
22	  field `L` of the test tower (base-field invariance of the genus, `chi_moduleKSheaf`
23	  + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the private lemma of `DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel`).
24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one` — **the fibre
25	  computation**: for a datum whose fibre class over `L` has `classDeg = n`, with `H¹` of
26	  the base-changed sheaf vanishing, `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1` — the Riemann–Roch anchor
27	  `h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` (`n + (1 − n)`) read through the presentation
28	  bridge `presentationSheafIso`.  The fibre geometric package is threaded as instance
29	  arguments (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`).
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one` — **Σ-RANK1,
31	  the datum-level export**: on the vanishing locus (fibre degree `n`, `χ = 1 − n`),
32	  `Module.rankAtStalk (H⁰(F_D)) p = 1`.  Route: `Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as
33	  the `κ(p)`-fibre dimension; `datumH0BaseChange` (on the nose) identifies the fibre with
34	  `H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`; the fibre computation above pins it at `1`.
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one` — the
36	  certified-family specialization (**N1**): for `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus
37	  `V`, the divisor datum `D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has invertible `H⁰`.  The
38	  fibre-degree hypothesis is discharged uniformly by `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass` (the
39	  fibre class has `classDeg = n` at every field).
40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum`
41	  — **N3, the generator kit**: since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of rank `1` (hence has a
42	  nontrivial fibre at every prime of the locus), a fibrewise-nonzero **global** section
43	  exists Zariski-locally (`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`).
44	
45	Noetherian discipline (worksheet §2): every rank statement carries `[IsNoetherianRing S]`
46	through the engine; the arbitrary-test consumers reach it through RE-5 stages.
47	-/

83	theorem chi_relCurve (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
84	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
85	    Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (n : ℤ) := by
86	  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C L).hom := instIsProperSndLeft C L
87	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
88	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C L
89	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
90	    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C L
91	  have h1 : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L)
92	      = 1 - (genus (baseChangeBundle C L) : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf (baseChangeBundle C L)
93	  have h2 : genus (baseChangeBundle C L) = genus C := genus_baseField C L
94	  have h3 : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genus C : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf C
95	  have h4 : (genus C : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) := by rw [h3] at hχ; linarith
96	  rw [h1, h2, h4]

105	`classDeg = n`, with the base χ-normalization and vanishing `H¹` of the base-changed
106	sheaf, the fibre global-section count is exactly `1` — the Riemann–Roch rank anchor
107	`h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` read through the presentation bridge
108	`presentationSheafIso`, at `n + (1 − n)`. -/
109	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one
110	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π)
111	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
112	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra S L] [IsScalarTower k S L]
113	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C L)]
114	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
115	    [QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
116	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0)]
117	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1)]
118	    (hg : classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ))
119	    (hsub : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1)) :
120	    Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = 1 := by
121	  set P : (relCurve C L).MeromorphicPresentation :=
122	    Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle (D.baseChange L).pointedCover
123	      (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange L).isGluingCocycle
124	        (D.baseChange L).pointedCover (D.baseChange L).pieceIndex
125	        fun _ => le_rfl) with hP
126	  have hsubP : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.gluedSheaf L) 1) :=
127	    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L)) 1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp
128	      hsub
129	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = Sheaf.h0 (P.gluedSheaf L) :=
130	    Sheaf.h0_congr (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))
131	  have hformula := h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi L P hsubP
132	  have hPclass : P.picClass = (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass := rfl
133	  have hint : (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) = 1 := by
134	    rw [h0eq, hformula, hPclass, hg, chi_relCurve hχ L]; ring
135	  exact_mod_cast hint

139	/-- **Σ-RANK1, the datum-level rank export** (worksheet GAP-3): on the fibrewise
140	h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization `χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`,
141	the datum engine's `H⁰` has stalk-rank exactly `1` at `p`.
142	
143	`Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as the `κ(p)`-dimension of the fibre
144	`κ(p) ⊗[S] H⁰`; the on-the-nose base change `datumH0BaseChange` identifies this fibre with
145	`H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`, whose dimension is `1` by the fibre computation. The global
146	fibrewise hypothesis `hfib` supplies finiteness/projectivity (hence flatness) through
147	`datumRigidEngine`. -/
148	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one
149	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π) [IsNoetherianRing S]
150	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
151	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
152	    (hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
153	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField))
154	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
155	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
156	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
157	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
158	    [QuasiCompact
159	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
160	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
161	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
162	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
163	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)]
164	    (hg : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
165	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ)) :
166	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
167	  obtain ⟨-, hfin, hproj⟩ := datumRigidEngine D hπ hfib
168	  haveI := hfin
169	  haveI := hproj
170	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1 := datum_subsingleton_pairH1 D hπ hfib
171	  have hfibre : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf = 1 :=
172	    D.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one hχ p.asIdeal.ResidueField hg
173	      (D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1)
174	  calc Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p
175	      = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
176	          (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)) :=
177	        Module.rankAtStalk_eq p
178	    _ = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
179	          (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 0) :=
180	        (D.datumH0BaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1).finrank_eq
181	    _ = Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf := rfl
182	    _ = 1 := hfibre

192	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
193	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]

217	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) [IsNoetherianRing S]
218	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
219	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
220	    (hvan : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S, (DivFam.mk G).toZar.IsH1VanishingAt p)

222	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
223	  have hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
224	      Subsingleton ((datumPair G.adaptation.divisorDatum).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
225	    fun q => (G.isH1VanishingAt_toZar_iff q).mp (hvan q)
226	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
227	    instIsIntegralBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
228	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
229	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
230	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField

232	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
233	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField

235	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0) :=
236	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
237	  haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
238	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :=
239	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
240	  exact G.adaptation.divisorDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one hπ hχ hfib p
241	    (G.classDeg_baseChange_divisorDatum p)
242	
243	/-- **N3 — the generator kit** (worksheet §2 (N3)): since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of
244	stalk-rank `1` on the locus, its `κ(p)`-fibre is nontrivial, so a fibrewise-nonzero
245	**global** section exists on a basic open `D(f) ∋ p` — the Zariski-local generator
246	(`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`, the Nakayama-neighbourhood kit of
247	`Picard/LocalGenerators.lean`). -/
248	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum
249	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) [IsNoetherianRing S]
250	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
251	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
252	    (hvan : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S, (DivFam.mk G).toZar.IsH1VanishingAt p)
253	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S) :
254	    ∃ f : S, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∃ q : Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0,
255	      ∀ q' : PrimeSpectrum S, f ∉ q'.asIdeal →
256	        (q ⊗ₜ (1 : q'.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
257	            Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S] q'.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
258	  have hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
259	      Subsingleton ((datumPair G.adaptation.divisorDatum).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
260	    fun q => (G.isH1VanishingAt_toZar_iff q).mp (hvan q)
261	  obtain ⟨-, hfin, hproj⟩ := datumRigidEngine G.adaptation.divisorDatum hπ hfib
262	  haveI := hfin
263	  haveI := hproj
264	  have hrank : Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) p = 1 :=
265	    G.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one hπ hχ hvan p
266	  -- rank 1 ⟹ the `κ(p)`-fibre is nontrivial
267	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
268	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) = 1 := by
269	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]; exact hrank
270	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S]
271	      Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) :=
272	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
273	  have hnt : Nontrivial (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S]
274	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
275	    (TensorProduct.comm S _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
276	  exact Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p hnt

16	/-!
17	# Gluing the datum-level divisor family over a Noetherian base
18	
19	Over a Noetherian `k`-algebra `R` a rank-one cocycle datum `D` — one whose fibre `H¹`
20	vanishes at every residue field and whose class has fibre degree `genus C` — is realised by
21	a single widened locally certified divisor family `F` with `F.picClass = D.cechPicClass`.
22	
23	The construction is Zariski-local-to-global on `Spec R`:
24	
25	* **Per prime** the Noetherian away-spreading theorem
26	  (`exists_away_away_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre`) produces, after two basic-open
27	  localizations, a divisor family whose class is the pulled datum class.  The double
28	  localization collapses to a single basic open of `R` by `IsLocalization.Away.mul_of_associated`.
29	* **Span** the good basic opens cover `Spec R`, so finitely many span the unit ideal
30	  (`exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime`).
31	* **Glue** the pieces agree on every overlap because the base-changed datum still has rank-one
32	  `H⁰` (`RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum` + `scalarExtension`), so the datum-class
33	  uniqueness core (`divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass`) forces agreement;
34	  the canonical away-span glue (`DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_awaySpan`) assembles a family `F₀`
35	  over `R`.
36	* **Class** the base-discrepancy killing on the base cover upgrades the per-piece class
37	  agreement to the on-the-nose equality `F₀.picClass = D.cechPicClass`.
38	
39	The degree is pinned to `genus C`: rank-one `H⁰` — which the gluing uniqueness core needs —
40	holds exactly when the fibre degree is the genus, so this is the shape the datum-descent
41	consumer applies.
42	-/

94	private def GoodAway (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi) (b : R) : Prop :=

99	has, after base change along the canonical map `Localization.Away a →ₐ[k] Localization.Away e`
100	of a factorization `a * c = e`, the base-changed datum class over `Localization.Away e`. -/
101	private lemma picClass_mapAlgHom_awayMulOfDvd (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi)
102	    (e a c : R) (hac : a * c = e)
103	    (F : DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away a) (genus C))
104	    (hF : F.picClass =
105	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away a)) D.cechPicClass) :
106	    (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd (k := k) e a c hac) F).picClass
107	      = (D.baseChange (Localization.Away e)).cechPicClass := by
108	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away e) :=
109	    (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd (k := k) e a c hac).toRingHom.toAlgebra
110	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away e) :=
111	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x =>
112	      ((DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd (k := k) e a c hac).commutes x).symm
113	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away e) :=
114	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x =>
115	      (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap (k := k) e a c hac x).symm
116	  rw [DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd (k := k) e a c hac)
117	      (fun _ => rfl), DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg, hF, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply,
118	    ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp,

122	-- Two localization towers and the canonical-carrier transport elaborate large sheaf terms

125	/-- **Per prime.**  Near every prime of a Noetherian base there is a basic open `D(b)` on
126	which the datum class is effective (the class of a widened divisor family).  The double away
127	localization of the Noetherian spreading theorem is collapsed to a single basic open of `R`. -/
128	private theorem exists_notMem_goodAway (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi) [IsNoetherianRing R]
129	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
130	    (hwit : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
131	    (hdeg : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower k R K],
132	      classDeg K (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R K) D.cechPicClass) = (genus C : ℤ))
133	    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
134	    ∃ b : R, b ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ GoodAway D b := by
135	  obtain ⟨h, hh, q₁, hq₁, f, hf, q₂, hq₂, F₀, hF₀⟩ :=
136	    D.exists_away_away_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre hpi (genus C) (genus C)
137	      (chi_moduleKSheaf C) le_rfl p (hwit p) (hdeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
138	  -- the numerator of `f` over `Localization.Away h`
139	  set a : R := (IsLocalization.Away.sec h f).1 with ha
140	  have hassoc : Associated (algebraMap R (Localization.Away h) a) f :=
141	    IsLocalization.Away.associated_sec_fst h f
142	  -- `Localization.Away f` is an away localization of `R` at `h * a` (canonical `R`-algebra
143	  -- tower `R → Localization.Away h → Localization.Away f`)
144	  haveI : IsLocalization.Away (h * a) (Localization.Away f) :=
145	    IsLocalization.Away.mul_of_associated h a f hassoc
146	  set b : R := h * a with hb
147	  -- `b` lies outside `p`
148	  have hap : a ∉ p.asIdeal := by
149	    have hpq : p.asIdeal = q₁.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away h)) := by
150	      rw [← hq₁]; rfl
151	    rw [hpq, Ideal.mem_comap]
152	    intro hmem
153	    refine hf ?_
154	    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hassoc
155	    rw [← hu]
156	    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hmem
157	  have hbp : b ∉ p.asIdeal := fun hmem => (p.isPrime.mem_or_mem hmem).elim hh hap
158	  -- transport `F₀` to the canonical carrier `Localization.Away b`
159	  let e : Localization.Away f ≃ₐ[R] Localization.Away b :=
160	    IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers b) (Localization.Away f) (Localization.Away b)
161	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away f) (Localization.Away b) :=
162	    (e.restrictScalars k).toAlgHom.toRingHom.toAlgebra
163	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) (Localization.Away b) :=
164	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => ((e.restrictScalars k).commutes x).symm
165	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away f) (Localization.Away b) :=
166	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (e.commutes x).symm
167	  refine ⟨b, hbp, DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (e.restrictScalars k).toAlgHom F₀, ?_⟩
168	  rw [DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (e.restrictScalars k).toAlgHom (fun _ => rfl),
169	    DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg, hF₀, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
170	    relCurveMap_comp]

172	/-- **`relPic` away-span separatedness.**  Two Čech Picard classes on `relCurve C A` whose
173	base changes along `relCurveMap C A (Localization.Away (b i))` agree, for a finite family `b`
174	spanning the unit ideal, have equal image in `relPic C (overSpec k A)`.
175	
176	The étale unit `PicEtAff.unit` is injective (`PicEtAff.unit_injective`) and natural
177	(`PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit`, `relPicAlgMap_mk`), so the claim is the Zariski separatedness of the
178	étale plus construction `PicEtAff.eq_of_away_eq`.  (The on-the-nose Čech equality is false in
179	general: the two classes may differ by a base Picard bundle trivialized on the cover.) -/
180	private lemma relPicMk_eq_of_awaySpan {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
181	    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : ι → A) (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range b) = ⊤)
182	    {L L' : (relCurve C A).CechPic}
183	    (h : ∀ i, Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C A (Localization.Away (b i))) L
184	        = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C A (Localization.Away (b i))) L') :
185	    relPicMk C (overSpec k A) L = relPicMk C (overSpec k A) L' := by
186	  apply PicEtAff.unit_injective C A
187	  refine PicEtAff.eq_of_away_eq C b (fun i => Localization.Away (b i)) hspan (fun i => ?_)
188	  rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit, PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit, relPicAlgMap_mk, relPicAlgMap_mk]
189	  exact congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C (Localization.Away (b i)))
190	    (congrArg (relPicMk C (overSpec k (Localization.Away (b i)))) (h i))

193	-- The gluing compatibility base-changes the rank-one certificates over each overlap and
194	-- runs the datum-class uniqueness core; the two localization towers are large.
195	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
196	/-- **The datum-level glued divisor producer over a Noetherian base.**  A rank-one cocycle
197	datum — one whose fibre `H¹` vanishes at every residue field (`hwit`) and whose class has
198	fibre degree `genus C` (`hdeg`) — is realised over a Noetherian base by a single widened
199	locally certified divisor family, matching the datum's Čech class in the relative Picard
200	group `relPic C (overSpec k R)`.
201	
202	The degree is pinned to `genus C`: the gluing uniqueness core needs rank-one `H⁰`, which
203	holds exactly when the fibre degree is the genus.  The conclusion is stated in `relPic`
204	rather than on the nose in `(relCurve C R).CechPic` because the glued class is determined by
205	the datum only up to a base Picard bundle (the on-the-nose equality is false in general);
206	`relPic` is where the base discrepancy is quotiented out, and it is the invariant the abelian
207	Abel map and the datum-descent consumer read. -/
208	theorem exists_glued_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre
209	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi) [IsNoetherianRing R]
210	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
211	    (hwit : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
212	    (hdeg : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower k R K],
213	      classDeg K (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R K) D.cechPicClass) = (genus C : ℤ)) :
214	    ∃ F : DivFamZarAff C R (genus C),
215	      relPicMk C (overSpec k R) F.picClass = relPicMk C (overSpec k R) D.cechPicClass := by
216	  classical
217	  -- the four rank-one certificates for the datum over `R` (arbitrary-ring producer)
218	  have cert : RankOneFamilyCertificates D :=
219	    RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum D hpi hwit hdeg
220	  -- per prime: a good basic open; quasi-compactness makes finitely many span the unit ideal
221	  obtain ⟨m, b, hspan, hgood⟩ :=
222	    exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime (GoodAway D)
223	      (fun p => D.exists_notMem_goodAway hpi hwit hdeg p)
224	  choose F hF using hgood
225	  -- on each overlap the two restricted pieces agree, by datum-class uniqueness at the
226	  -- base-changed rank-one datum
227	  have hcompat : ∀ i j : Fin m,
228	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) b i j) (F i)
229	        = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) b i j) (F j) := by
230	    intro i j
231	    have cert' : RankOneFamilyCertificates (D.baseChange (Localization.Away (b i * b j))) :=
232	      cert.scalarExtension (Localization.Away (b i * b j))
233	    refine divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass
234	      (D.baseChange (Localization.Away (b i * b j)))
235	      cert'.h1_vanishing cert'.h0_finite cert'.h0_projective cert'.h0_rank_one _ _ ?_ ?_
236	    · exact D.picClass_mapAlgHom_awayMulOfDvd (b i * b j) (b i) (b j) rfl (F i) (hF i)
237	    · exact D.picClass_mapAlgHom_awayMulOfDvd (b i * b j) (b j) (b i)
238	        (mul_comm (b j) (b i)) (F j) (hF j)
239	  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ := DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_awaySpan b hspan F hcompat
240	  refine ⟨F₀, ?_⟩
241	  -- the glued family restricts on each piece to the pulled datum class
242	  have hpiece : ∀ p : Fin m,
243	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (b p))) F₀.picClass
244	        = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (b p))) D.cechPicClass :=
245	    fun p => by
246	      rw [← hF p, ← DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg,
247	        ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg
248	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R (Localization.Away (b p))) (fun _ => rfl), hF₀ p]
249	  refine relPicMk_eq_of_awaySpan (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => b l.down) ?_
250	    (fun l => hpiece l.down)
251	  rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => b l.down) = Set.range b from
252	    ULift.down_surjective.range_comp b]
253	  exact hspan

      (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K₁ (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx' 1))

    exact (Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_pullback _ _ _).symm

      = Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K₂ (Scheme.presentationDivisor K₂

    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor,
      Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_picClass]

/-- **E-iv-alg** (worksheet §2, the keystone): the degree of a Čech Picard class of the
base-changed curve is invariant under base-field transition — for every `k`-algebra map
`φ : K₁ →ₐ[k] K₂` of field extensions and every class `L` on `C_{K₁}`,

`classDeg K₂ (CechPic.map π L) = classDeg K₁ L`,

where `π := (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left`.  Proved by the §2 ladder: reduce along the
surjective additive class map `CurveDivisor.picClass K₁` to one-point divisors, present the
point class by the tracked point equations, pull the presentation back along `π`, and close
with the fiber-degree identity (†). -/
theorem classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition (φ : K₁ →ₐ[k] K₂)
    (L : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left.CechPic) :
    classDeg K₂ (Scheme.CechPic.map ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left) L) = classDeg K₁ L := by
  obtain ⟨D, rfl⟩ := Scheme.CurveDivisor.exists_picClass_eq K₁ L
  suffices h : ∀ f : {p : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left //
      p ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left} →₀ ℤ,
      classDeg K₂ (Scheme.CechPic.map ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left)
        (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K₁ f))
        = classDeg K₁ (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K₁ f) from h D
  intro f
  induction f using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
    change classDeg K₂ (Scheme.CechPic.map ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left)
      (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K₁ (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left.CurveDivisor)))

    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, map_one, classDeg_one, classDeg_one]
